Notices to the people who sign in: a new order for the admins, a task's status changed for its owner. Sent from your code (notifications.Send), or by the model's rules on the records of an entity (@notifications(on create, to user.admin, title "...")), written in the transaction of the change. Each person lists, counts and reads their own; frontends show them under a bell.

```esquadro
blueprint notifications
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [domain](../domain/), [postgres](../postgres/), [migrations](../migrations/), [store](../store/), [security](../security/), [http](../http/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [jobs](../jobs/), [rest](../rest/), [client_ts](../client_ts/), [spa](../spa/), [testcontainers](../testcontainers/) when the app uses them.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `poll_seconds` | int | `30` | Seconds between a frontend's checks for new notices; 0 checks only when a page opens and when its window comes back to the front. |
| `retention_days` | int | `90` | Days a notice read is kept, then deleted by a daily job and &lt;app> notifications purge; 0 keeps them. |
| `page_size` | int | `10` | How many notices a frontend's bell shows. |
| `locale` | string | `""` | The language a notice writes a record's values in (an amount, a date): pt-BR, en; empty, the first frontend's. |

```esquadro
blueprint notifications {
  poll_seconds 30
}
```

## Annotations

| Where | Key | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| entity | `on` | list | When to notify: create, update (with when, only when one of those fields changed), delete. |
| entity | `when` | fields | The fields an update notifies about; any, without them. |
| entity | `to` | list | Whom: a realm's people (user), its role's (user.admin), or the record's owner (owner). Who made the change is never notified. |
| entity | `title` | string | The notice's title and text; {field} is the record's field. |
| entity | `text` | string |  |

An annotation is written `@notifications(key value)` on the element.
